description: §5.2 executable-sink rule (S456 review F2): a quoted onclick with `${…}` spliced in by `^{ emit(…) }` is refused — the check runs over the post-meta AST.
rationale: §5.2 executable-sink rule applies "in every position (… and markup spliced in by `^{ emit(…) }`)". Before the fix the meta-emitted handler compiled to `setAttribute("onclick", `go('${…}')`)` at exit 0, because VP-3 runs before ME.
